terminology_decisions: GameHQ, GameInput, XInput, DualSense, HDR, FPS, Steam, Playnite, GitHub, API names, paths, commands, shortcut keys, placeholders, and versions remain unchanged.
French uses manette, bouton, affectation, emplacement, and entrée; input listening never uses the media-capture sense.
Press is immediate Appui; release-based Tap is Appui bref; Double appui, Triple appui, and Appui long remain distinct, and completed Hold suppresses Tap.
Replay names the feature, tampon de replay its rolling recording, clip a saved video, enregistrement the recording process, and lecture ordinary playback.
Capture, capture d’écran, image, galerie, bibliothèque, surcouche, and zone de notification denote distinct product concepts.
Update security uses manifeste, somme de contrôle, signature, préparation, transaction, état de confiance, and corruption de données.
Portable import uses portable, préparé, journal, chaîne, racine, source, instance, base de données, and clé étrangère; portable:/ stays literal.
French uses two Qt numerus forms and maintains correct agreement for captures, folders, minutes, and seconds.
Controls use concise infinitives; explanatory sentences use neutral metropolitan French and French punctuation spacing.
calibration_rules: Review every stable ID with its English source, location, control role, and neighboring UI; schema validity is not linguistic evidence.
Use concise infinitive controls and neutral idiomatic French for explanatory prose.
Preserve placeholders, protected identifiers, shortcut keys, button names, paths, commands, punctuation tokens, and versions.
Review application, installer, Playnite, native launcher, startup, and release-note surfaces separately.
Resolve capture, replay, controller input, filesystem, database, and update-security terms from product context.
Avoid touchscreen toucher for controller-button gestures and preserve activation timing.
